purpose: Record case-law review status separately for each property-title proposition and prevent secondary summaries from being treated as judicial authority.

cases.use: Interpretation of s.31 and statutory registration framework.

review_rules: Primary judgments must be reviewed before being relied upon for a public legal proposition.
A case explains/interprets law; it does not silently amend legislation.
A case involving a different statutory provision or factual issue must not be generalized without analysis.
Case-law status is separate from statutory amendment/commencement status.
Unreviewed case-law gaps block publication of propositions that depend materially on judicial interpretation.
